free_tier.stated: At least 50 GB of artifact data + 200 GB of package delivery per month, free, pooled across ALL open-source repositories in one org. 'You get at least 50GB of artifact data + 200GB of package delivery for free, across all open-source repositories.' Available on the $0 Core plan, no special plan needed.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.notes: extracted from the quota or limits prose

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: No retention clause documented in available terms.

egress.terms: 200 GB/month of 'package delivery' included, then metered (Core has no overage path at all: 'Additional data: N/A'; the settings cap is '200% of plan'). Delivery counts only outgoing bytes, partial downloads prorated, requests not charged.

interface_detail: rest (Cloudsmith REST API + CLI), plus every native package client: apt/yum/npm/pypi/nuget/helm/docker/raw; public broadcast URLs on dl.cloudsmith.io
tooling: cloudsmith-cli (`cloudsmith push raw OWNER/REPO FILE`), REST API v1, Terraform provider, officially documented; anonymous pulls need no token (probe below).
chaining: Usage is pooled per org, not per repo. So the multiplier is orgs, not repos: unlimited free signups × 50 GB + 200 GB/mo. OSS status is granted automatically at repo creation ('We don't require advance permission to create open-source repositories'), with post-hoc checks; sponsorship raises the allowance for large projects.
limits_note: 5 GB maximum per file ('the current maximum file size is 5GB'); 50 GB total artifact data and 200 GB/mo delivery per org; artifact data billed as a high-water mark within the billing period (upload-then-delete does not refund); 28+ formats plus arbitrary raw files; OSS repos must carry an SPDX licence, a project URL and a Cloudsmith attribution badge.

identity_cost.detail: derived from the record's prose: Hosted CDN with CLI and API access. Repositories that fail open-source eligibility rules are subject to administrative removal.

reliability_note: Real hosted CDN with a real CLI/API; the risk is administrative, not technical. OSS repos that fail the eligibility rules (no attribution, minor fork) get suspended, and the free Core plan cannot pay overage so it hard-stops at the cap.
confidence_note: Unverified: carried from historical research records without live verification. A first-party page read confirms documentation.

evidence.proved: read live: 'You get at least 50GB of artifact data + 200GB of package delivery for free, across all open-source repositories'; 'Usage for open-source repositories is tracked separately'; 'We don't require advance permission to create open-source repositories'
read live: Core $0 = 'Artifact data 500 MB / Package delivery 1 GB / Additional data N/A'; Pro $149 = 5 GB / 25 GB / $1.50 per GB; 'Number of packages / repositories: Unlimited' on every tier
read live FAQ: 'the current maximum file size is 5GB'
probe: GET -> 200 (anonymous download, no token); GET https://api.cloudsmith.io/v1/packages/cloudsmith/cli/?page=1&page_size=1 -> 200 with full package JSON (anonymous read API)
